_note: Every number in this repo that came from a measurement rather than from a rule of the game. Each entry says where the literal lives, which harness re-derives it, and how far it may drift before somebody should look. tools/constants-audit.mjs enforces it; tools/guard.mjs runs the audit. Adding measured math WITHOUT adding it here is the thing this file exists to stop: a constant nobody re-derives is a fossil, and fossils have cost this project more than bugs have.

_wired_key.yes: the consumer reads league/measured.json; the literal is only a fallback
_wired_key.no: the consumer carries a bare literal; re-running the harness changes nothing until a human retypes it
_wired_key.n/a: not a statistical estimate; it is a policy choice or a rule of the game

constants.what: Pooled median coefficient of variation, used to scale the correlation betas. Distinct from the per-position table below, which sets the spread of a simulated week.
constants.source: nflverse weekly scoring, 2021-2025, median over players with a real role
constants.pending: this kit does not ship a correlation-fitting harness, so nothing re-derives it yet. The literal is a population-level default, not an estimate specific to any one league.

constants.what: Coefficient of variation for QB, setting the spread of a simulated week. Getting this wrong moves every win probability at once, which makes it the most consequential number in the simulator. tools/check-sim.mjs tests lib/sim.mjs's output against this same figure.

constants.what: Points of season value inside which two bench players are treated as equal, so bye-week cover can break the tie when ranking who to drop. A policy choice about how much value to trade for schedule coverage, not an estimate of anything.
Points per game a player who did not practice loses against his own average, for a player who plays (not for one who sits).
constants.pending: this kit does not ship the backtest that fits this figure, so nothing re-derives it yet. The literal is a population-level default from nflverse's public injury reports, not an estimate specific to any one league.
